title: Autobahnkreuz – Wikipedia
content: Learn more about Autobahnkreuz on Wikipedia. Autobahnkreuz is a German term for a type of intersection in the German autobahn network.

title: Frankfurter Kreuz
content: The Frankfurter Kreuz (Frankfurt Junction) is an Autobahn interchange in Frankfurt am Main, Germany, where the autobahns A3 and A5 meet.

title: Autobahnkreuz Walldorf interchange, A5 and A6 ...
